definitions.explanation: The impulsive energy and lack of restraint characteristic of young people. Almost always appears in the fixed expression 若気の至り (a youthful indiscretion).

examples.japanese: {若気|わかげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{至|いた}りだった。
⟦あれ→あれ：00916_are⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{若気|わかげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{至|いた}りで、⟦{今|いま}→今：00945_ima⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: That was a youthful indiscretion, and I regret it now.

examples.japanese: {若気|わかげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{至|いた}り⟦とはいえ→とはいえ：06282_tohaie⟧、{取|と}り{返|かえ}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つかないこと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまった。
examples.english: Even though it was the recklessness of youth, I did something that can't be undone.

notes:
USAGE:
Almost exclusively used in the set phrase {若気|わかげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{至|いた}り (youthful indiscretion, literally "the culmination of youthful impetuousness"). This expression is used when looking back on something reckless or foolish done in one's youth. It carries a tone of self-deprecation or rueful reflection.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {若気|わかげ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{至|いた}り (youthful indiscretion — the primary usage)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {血気|けっき}: hot-bloodedness — youthful reckless energy, as in {血気|けっき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はやる (to act rashly out of youthful ardor)
- ⟦{青|あお}い→青い：00586_aoi⟧: immature, green — describes someone who lacks experience
